I noticed that very few, if any subverses appear to have custom themes or colours, so I thought I'd share with you a piece of the style sheet that I've created for those of you who either don't have the time to figure out css or haven’t started theming yet and would like a basic head start:

//This controls the header. You can change the colour as well as background image.
#header-container
{
background: gray;
}

//Controls colour and style of subverse name
.pagename a
{
color: white;
font-family: serif;
}

//colour and style of subverse menu text
.tabmenu li.disabled a
{
color: white;
}

Simply go to your subverse settings page and plop the bit above into the "stylesheet" box, modify to suit your needs, and hit save.

UPDATE: 17/08/15

Thanks to those at /v/scribble, /v/cashmere and /v/typogra, you don't really need to start from scratch and make your own stylesheet anymore, as you've got plenty of complete stylesheets to chose from. I do understand there are those of you who would prefer to make something entirely on your own. If that's you, here you are, and all power to you.
